notes.title: Free Birthdays DLC Patch, Including Prinny, Dood! + Future Patch Fixes
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308631/8e4ac767fcf664362845e89c6c7f1de5ff109328.jpg

Hello Everyone!

We're happy to announce a new Birthdays the Beginning DLC patch that will allow players to access 6 DLC sets and a Prinny Doll DLC for free! Please note that all items are strictly ornamental.

DLC Descriptions:
Prinny Doll - Includes the ornamental "Prinny Doll" item, a tribute to the beloved Disgaea mascot.
Kunio and Riki Set - The prolific high school punks burst onto the scene in Birthdays the Beginning. The Kunio and Riki Set contains the characters Kunio and Riki. 
World Flag Set - The World Flag Set contains the national flags of the following countries: America, Canada, UK, Italy, Netherlands, Sweden, Spain, Germany, France, Russia, South Korea, China, and Japan.
World Monument Set - The World Monument Set contains the following items: Pyramid, Stonehenge, Moai Statue, Totem Pole, Obelisk, and Chichen Itza.
Zen Garden Set - The Zen Garden contains the following items: Pond & Bridge, Stone Lantern, Large Bushes, Fence, Gate, and Sozu.
Cube Creator DX Set - The Cube Creator DX Set contains the following items: Cube & Brothers, Cube & Animals, and Cube & Monsters.
Desert Rat Squad Set - Desert Rat Squad Set contains the Desert Rat and Devil Cat items.

Lastly, we'd like to announce upcoming patches that will fix the following issues that the community has been vocal about:
[olist]
FPS issues & Cursor Lag
Polishing control schemes for keyboard and controller users
[/olist]
We are looking to provide more updates by September. 

We appreciate everyone's patience with our patches and our devs are working hard to get these issues fixed.

Thanks again for everyone's support!

Best,
NISA Team

notes.title: New default branch to help with graphical issues / game slowdown
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We have put up a new default branch of the game.
The main fix in this branch is the ability to tinker with graphical options. 
These options can be accessed from here: 

1. Start new game or load save data. 
2. Press Esc Key to open sub menu
3. Choose Graphics Settings. 

Here you will be able to change:

Shadow Setting
Draw Quality Setting
Background Setting

As I mentioned in my previous post I was able to double the FPS performance by lowering these settings, so those of you with FPS issues please give this a try. 

We are still working very hard to make this game more optimized for PC so hang on tight for more updates. 

Thank you.

Prinny Toshi

notes.title: Additional Announcement Regarding Current Beta Build (6/13/2017) - BETTER FPS!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We made an announcement about a week ago (8 days to be exact) saying we added keyboard key configuration options. 

What I (Prinny Toshi) overlooked was that, by following the steps below there are additional graphics options not in the options menu. 

1. Start new game or load save data. 
2. Press Esc Key to open sub menu
3. Choose Graphics Settings. 

In this menu you are able to change these settings. 

Shadow Setting
Draw Quality Setting
Background Setting

Personally I was able to DOUBLE my FPS from around 20~30 to 50~60. 

We are still working very hard to make this game more optimized for PC so hang on tight for more updates. 

Thank you... dood.

Prinny Toshi

notes.title: Birthdays Update 5/18/2017
notes.content:
Hi all, 

NISA would like to announce that we have moved what was previously the beta branch up to the default branch. 

That being said, we are still working on making this game better to play on the PC, which includes but is not limited to:

1. More graphical options
2. Key configuration options
3. Overall PC optimization

Thank you for all the feedback you have given us and we hope to get this out to you all as soon as possible.

Prinny Toshi

notes.title: 5/14/2017 Beta Branch is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I hope everyone's weekend is going well!

After hearing all the feedback you guys have given us we have made some updates to the game. 

The updates are: 
1. Added an in-game exit button (there wasn't one before, for those of you who didn't notice)
2. Added option to choose which GPU the game uses (A more permanent fix to an issue many of you were having)
3. New Asian text has been applied. 

These changes can be accessed via the beta branch that is accessible here:

1) From your Steam Library, right click on "Birthdays the Beginning" and select “Properties”
2) Go to the “BETAS” tab
3) Select “beta” from the dropdown menu. This should start installing the beta version of Birthdays the Beginning 

Keep the feedback coming! We will continue to make this game more playable for everyone. 
Thanks, dood!

Prinny Toshi

---5/15/2017---
These languages have been updated to along with the changes mentioned above. 

Japanese
Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese
Korean

notes.title: Official Announcement Regarding Playability and Functionality
notes.content:
The Improvement to the Controls, Graphics, and Overall Playability of the game.

Thank you all for either playing or being interested in the game Birthdays the Beginning. 
We garnered tons of attention by releasing this game on PC at the same time as console (PS4) but we at NISA feel that we let many people down. 

We have received tons of feedback regarding Birthdays the Beginning and we feel the 2 reasons below are the biggest issues with this game so far. 
1.	The controls of the game are not optimized for PC
2.	The graphical aspect of the game is not optimized for PC. 

Currently we are in very close contact with the developers in order to fix these issues but at this very moment we cannot guarantee a date these issues will be fixed, but we will do our best to resolve the issue.
That being said, once we know an exact date we will definitely announce it here. 

For further details, see our Discussions post, which has specific instructions on a temporary fix for Radeon and Nvidia graphics cards:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/525700/discussions/0/2741975115067646379/
